title: Concept: Content-Security-Policy media-src allows a wildcard source
description: The Content-Security-Policy media-src directive contains a bare wildcard, so audio and video subresources may come from any origin. An attacker host that serves the media sees the request timing and any range requests, and can substitute content the page did not author.
applicability: HTTPS responses that send Content-Security-Policy with an explicit media-src directive.
risk: Media content and its consumption pattern are visible to any origin; LOW severity because the impact is disclosure rather than code execution.
